source: Calmly (the Magic Move demo Experience), republished from its source folder by the page-release exporter
purpose: UNIV-5597 (a): native text fields during in-page moves. Three Screens (plans, welcome with "Your name", session) with two published text input declarations and the step-1 and step-2 page transitions.
journeyMetadata: The Journey metadata is that of the Calmly v2 release the iOS simulator played (published build 01m5xgmzcztdwb3np7w1h80k4m); the scene, its transitions and its text inputs come from the publisher at the export head.
changes: descriptor.json is the exporter's signed descriptor, printed with sorted keys. The tests read it as an authenticated payload's declarations; they don't sign it
The two pictures are not copied: they publish as 1 by 1 stand-in PNGs, and the tests give them no bytes, so they draw nothing. Nothing else changed
